summary: Notes Nora keeps now record an arrangement in fixed sections (decided, open, owed, proposed, ruled out), each line citing the messages it came from, and a note whose record breaks that form is not written.
details: Dates in a note are written as calendar dates, never as «tomorrow» or «this Saturday».
People are named as the room's messages name them, and each attribution must be the author of a message the line cites.
An update rewrites the whole note as it now stands and cannot silently drop the evidence an earlier line rested on.
limitations: Notes written before this change keep their free-text record until the next update rewrites them.
